tools.name: go2clock_list_users
tools.description: List every clock user with id, name, department, shift, payroll number and manager flag. Clock PINs are removed. Go2Clock API: POST /api/users/.

tools.name: go2clock_list_employees
tools.description: List employee details: contact, department, trade, pay rates, roles, start and termination dates. Go2Clock API: POST /api/employees/.

tools.name: go2clock_list_clock_records
tools.description: List every clocking record (punch) for one date. Go2Clock API: POST /api/punches/ with punch_date.

tools.name: go2clock_list_clock_records_range
tools.description: List clocking records between two dates, optionally for one employee. Keep the range to 7 days or fewer per call; Go2Clock advises against larger pulls. Go2Clock API: POST /api/punches_range/.

tools.name: go2clock_get_timesheet_csv
tools.description: Generate the timesheet report as CSV for up to 7 days, optionally for one department or one employee. Returns the CSV text. Go2Clock API: POST /api/timesheet_csv_v1.

tools.name: go2clock_get_rota
tools.description: Read an employee's rota (shift schedule) between two dates: shift name, colour and planned hours per day. Go2Clock API: GET /api/employee_rota.

tools.name: go2clock_update_employee
tools.description: Change some details of one existing employee. Send only the fields to change. Go2Clock API: PUT /api/employee_update. Does not change sign-in passwords or roles.

tools.name: go2clock_upload_employees
tools.description: Upload a list of employees (new or changed). Go2Clock keys each record on userid. Sends a JSON array. Go2Clock API: PUT /api/employees/. Does not set passwords or roles.

tools.name: go2clock_upload_clock_record
tools.description: Add one clocking record (punch) for an employee. Go2Clock refuses a duplicate record. Go2Clock API: PUT /api/punches/.

tools.name: go2clock_create_rota
tools.description: Put a named shift on an employee's rota for one or more days from a start date. An existing rota entry on the same date is replaced. The shift name must match a shift in Go2Clock's shift settings. Go2Clock API: POST /api/employee_rota.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "go2clock_update_employee" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: go2clock_list_users, go2clock_list_employees, go2clock_list_clock_records, go2clock_list_clock_records_range, go2clock_get_timesheet_csv · Private data: go2clock_list_employees, go2clock_list_clock_records, go2clock_list_clock_records_range, go2clock_update_employee, go2clock_upload_employees, go2clock_upload_clock_record · Public sink: go2clock_list_users, go2clock_list_employees, go2clock_list_clock_records, go2clock_list_clock_records_range, go2clock_get_timesheet_csv, go2clock_update_employee, go2clock_upload_employees, go2clock_upload_clock_record, go2clock_create_rota.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: go2clock_list_users, go2clock_list_employees, go2clock_list_clock_records, go2clock_list_clock_records_range, go2clock_get_timesheet_csv · Private data: go2clock_list_employees, go2clock_list_clock_records, go2clock_list_clock_records_range, go2clock_update_employee, go2clock_upload_employees, go2clock_upload_clock_record · Public sink: go2clock_list_users, go2clock_list_employees, go2clock_list_clock_records, go2clock_list_clock_records_range, go2clock_get_timesheet_csv, go2clock_update_employee, go2clock_upload_employees, go2clock_upload_clock_record, go2clock_create_rota

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
